name: Michael McAtee
biography: is a senior security consultant at Crowe Horwath and responsible for management of Crowe's Security Penetration & Forensics labs. With a passion for programming and security, Michael has been involved in developing security tools for automation and assessment needs at Crowe. Michael's experience includes enterprise Windows administration, enterprise network design, penetration testing, and security consulting and is part of over 35 security engagements annually.
